title: Stage10 BSF×NMEE peer research matrix
scope: Primary publisher original abstracts and some open full text; NOT exhaustive full-SM equation-level audit.

evidence_legend.A_official_publisher_abstract: facts that appear in original journal abstract only; do not overclaim full text review

matrix.title: Nonlinear Magnetoelectric Edelstein Effect
matrix.author_established: intrinsic/extrinsic spin quantum geometry; intrinsic survives in insulators
matrix.difference: same cooperative EB spin observable family; NOT yet shown equal to our equilibrium static gamma
matrix.novelty_preemption: do not claim first insulating intrinsic NMEE

matrix.title: Layer Edelstein Effect
matrix.author_established: bilayer layer opposite spin; 80 layer group symmetry framework
matrix.difference: our equilibrium static EB response differs from current driven LEE
matrix.novelty_preemption: hidden layer-spin existence/stacking symmetry not by itself novel

matrix.title: Prediction of a layer nonlinear Hall effect in bilayer nonmagnetic or antiferromagnetic systems
matrix.author_established: 80 layer groups, exact net cancellation, electric field unveiling
matrix.difference: current versus static spin susceptibility with Bz
matrix.novelty_preemption: hidden layer odd+total zero rule already demonstrated in a different transport response
matrix.required_followup: compare angular/magnetic/source parity and actual finite layer response

matrix.title: Multistate manipulation of charge-spin conversion in two-dimensional ferroelectric bilayers
matrix.author_established: EE reverses by polarization; anti-parallel state extinguishes EE
matrix.difference: our static insulating EB response instead of metallic EE
matrix.novelty_preemption: switchable ferroelectric Edelstein alone not novel
matrix.required_followup: show different angular and Bz-odd signature plus finite response

matrix.title: Rashba splitting in bilayer transition metal dichalcogenides controlled by electronic ferroelectricity
matrix.author_established: FE reverses Rashba texture in WSe2/MoS2 class
matrix.difference: spin texture is not static mixed curvature response
matrix.novelty_preemption: FE Rashba sign switching not new
matrix.required_followup: demonstrate WSe2 spinor off-diagonal matrix elements

matrix.title: Tunable Edelstein effect in the intrinsic two-dimensional ferroelectric metal PtBi2
Spin Transport Revealed by Spin Quantum Geometry
matrix.author_established: unifies spin currents and spin magnetization, nonlinear Drude spin
matrix.difference: our spin-source geometry inherits broad toolkit
matrix.required_followup: explain actual additional layer / sliding physics

matrix.title: Quantum metric induced nonlinear Edelstein effect and giant intrinsic antidamping spin-orbit torque
matrix.author_established: quantum metric interband coherence and nonlinear spin torque
matrix.novelty_preemption: mixed metric spin nonlinear physics not generically new

matrix.title: Intrinsic Magnetoelectric Hall Effect from Layer-Orbital Quantum Geometry
matrix.author_established: layer polarization+orbital moment coherence persists in gap
matrix.difference: our operator is spin magnetization, not charge Hall; spin-only B vs orbital B
matrix.novelty_preemption: mixed EB layer quantum geometry concept adjacent not new
matrix.required_followup: do not falsely list as published Science

matrix.title: Sliding Ferroelectric Control of Unconventional Magnetism in Stacked Bilayers
matrix.observable: FE connection operator magnetic spin splitting/AHE
matrix.difference: different altermagnetic order vs nonmagnetic static spin
matrix.novelty_preemption: connection operator/group enumeration not standalone new idea
matrix.required_followup: reuse symmetry mapping but add computed response

matrix.title: Highly tunable band structure in ferroelectric R-stacked bilayer WSe2
matrix.author_established: exciton spectroscopy AB/BA, CB Lambda VB K, switching
matrix.difference: does not calculate our static spin gamma
matrix.novelty_preemption: WSe2 FE and band switching pre-existing
matrix.required_followup: full 2D BZ spin texture sampled and total/layer gamma

matrix.title: Non-relativistic torque and Edelstein effect in non-collinear magnets
matrix.observable: spin-E interband response even in gap
matrix.author_established: linear current/field torque interband Berry terms
matrix.difference: static spin response has prior interband in-gap parallels
matrix.novelty_preemption: do not say all Edelstein purely metallic Fermi surface

matrix.title: Mixed Weyl semimetals and low-dissipation magnetization control in insulators by spin-orbit torques
matrix.author_established: mixed parameter geometry and insulating low-dissipation spin orbit response
matrix.difference: our finite-B derivative+layer projector more specific
matrix.novelty_preemption: mixed Berry curvature insulating spin effect not new

matrix.title: Direct and inverse spin-orbit torques
matrix.observable: Kubo spin orbit torque and inverse relation
matrix.author_established: established microscopic Kubo response and reciprocity
matrix.difference: not our exact layer spin static third order
matrix.novelty_preemption: do not claim generic Kubo mixed Berry approach first
matrix.required_followup: compare source operators and actual measurable units
